6d8d62464d5b9f44.description: Job Purpose : We are seeking a highly skilled ETL Data Engineer to re-engineer our existing data pipelines to extract data from a new data source (PostgreSQL / CURA system) instead of the current Microsoft SQL Server (CRM persistence store), while preserving the existing load patterns to Elasticsearch and MongoDB. The engineer will ensure this migration has zero impact on data quality, system performance, or end-user experience. Key Responsibilities : - Analyze existing ETL pipelines and their dependencies on Microsoft SQL Server as source systems. - Design and implement modifications to repoint ETL extractions from PostgreSQL (CURA) while preserving the current transformations and load logic into Elasticsearch and MongoDB. - Ensure end-to-end data integrity, quality, and freshness remain unaffected after the source switch. - Write efficient and optimized SQL queries to extract data from the current source. - Conduct performance testing to confirm no degradation of pipeline throughput or latency in production. - Work closely with DevOps and platform teams to containerize, orchestrate, and deploy the updated ETLs using Docker and Kubernetes. - Monitor post-deployment performance and handle any production issues proactively. - Document design, code, data mappings, and operational runbooks. Required Skills and Qualifications : - Strong experience building and maintaining large-scale distributed data systems. - Expert-level proficiency in Python, especially data analysis/manipulation libraries like pandas, NumPy, and Polars. - Advanced SQL development skills with proven experience in performance optimization. - Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes. - Familiarity with Elasticsearch and MongoDB as data stores. - Experience working in production environments with mission-critical systems. .

6d67af42beeb60d1.description:
We're looking for a Senior Marketing Analyst to join our Analytics Engineering team and take ownership of marketing performance analysis across our client portfolio. This is a senior individual contributor role; you'll be handling complex, high-spend accounts independently, mentoring junior analysts, and serving as the go-to expert on marketing data and attribution for your clients. You'll be replacing a senior team member, so we need someone who can hit the ground running, not someone learning the fundamentals on the job.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Own end-to-end marketing analytics for multiple client accounts, from data validation to insight delivery
2. Analyze performance across all major ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Snapchat Ads, Bing Ads) and translate spend data into actionable recommendations
3. Build and maintain attribution models to determine true channel performance and ROI
4. Work directly with GA4 (BigQuery export) to conduct deep-dive analysis: funnel analysis, user journeys, event-level investigation, cohort behavior
5. Manage and troubleshoot data from Adobe Analytics where applicable
6. Work with third-party attribution and analytics platforms including Northbeam and Triple Whale to validate and cross-check attribution data
7. Analyze Shopify data (orders, AOV, customer LTV, product performance) and reconcile it against marketing platform reporting
8. Work with Stripe payment data for revenue reconciliation and subscription/LTV analysis
9. Integrate and analyze CRM data (HubSpot, Salesforce, or client-specific CRMs) for full-funnel visibility
10. Identify data discrepancies across platforms (e.g., GA4 vs Shopify vs ad platform numbers) and determine root causes
11. Build dashboards and reports that clients actually use to make decisions
12. Conduct A/B test analysis: statistical significance, lift, segment-level breakdowns
13. Present findings and recommendations directly to clients in a clear, non-technical way
14. Mentor junior analysts on the team, review their work, and maintain quality standards
15. Proactively flag anomalies, risks, or opportunities in client marketing data before clients ask.
